digest.component_or_area: tickets store epoch migration (A6-1 publication & reclamation window)
propositions: Execute a one-time force-push rewrite of the tickets branch to reclaim ~92% of storage after all writers are quiesced, gated on operator-confirmed zero active sessions and stopped MCP servers.
Verify epoch-mismatch refusal through live review-bot deployment and explicitly refreshed host runtime probes before publishing the rewrite.
Converge all 48 sibling worktrees and the four other host trackers by resetting to the rewritten origin/tickets.
Assert non-resurrection by confirming the old tip is not an ancestor of the rewritten branch and measuring pack growth <1 MB after the deterministic first post-window write.
Land the rebar.toml identity.enforce_since re-pin through Gerrit with mapped commit SHA, allowing normal CI flow because require_authenticated=false skips early.
Validate post-enable reconciliation by green reconcile-bridge/canary runs, CLI subprocess verification of zero mutation/recovery failures, and clean rebar fsck.
